name: Polar Coordinate Fourier Volume Rendering
aliases: Fourier volume rendering by polar coordinate data representation
Polar Coordinate Fourier Volume Rendering (Polar FVR)
definition: A volume rendering technique that stores and processes frequency domain data in polar coordinates to reduce computational complexity from O(n^2 log n) to O(n^2) and improve memory access efficiency.
summary: Polar Coordinate Fourier Volume Rendering reduces computational complexity to O(n^2) by storing frequency data in polar coordinates, enabling fast nearest-neighbor interpolation instead of trilinear interpolation.
